region.tikal.intro: Tikal is a vast city in the rainforest: white temple-pyramids taller than the treetops, plazas, reservoirs and tens of thousands of people around them. Its kings sometimes rule their neighbours and sometimes pay tribute to their enemies.
region.calakmul.intro: Calakmul is the capital of the Snake kingdom, Kaanul. Its lords place their own men on thrones across the lowlands, and in the rainy season the swamps around the city fill with water.
region.palenque.intro: Palenque, known locally as Lakamha, "Big Water", sits on forested hills where streams run out of the rock. From here you can see the plain all the way to the Usumacinta River, and the palace is ruled by the heirs of great Pakal.
region.copan.intro: Copán lies in a green valley in the south of the Maya world. It has the finest sculptors and scribes: the kings’ stelae are carved so deeply that the stone seems alive.
